title: Floor roots and exact powers of integer square roots
summary: integer_nthroot returns the floored integer root and a flag indicating whether the input is an exact power.
applies: Integer modulo arithmetic; modulus greater than 1
detail: 80 has a fourth integer root of 2 and is exactly marked as false; 81 returns 3 and is marked as true.
boundary: Converting a large integer to a floating point and then taking the square root may result in incorrect selection of adjacent integers due to rounding. Candidates can be directly back-substituted using integer powers.
relevance: When recovering integers from higher power data, distinguish between approximate candidates and values that strictly satisfy the equation.
